```plato

    //==
    // # Recovering strain and stress
    //
    // A displacement field is not what an engineer looks at. Strain is its
    // symmetrised gradient, stress follows from strain by Hooke's law, and von
    // Mises stress is the scalar those two get reduced to before anyone colours a
    // picture with it. Over a constant-gradient element all three are constant,
    // so each is one value per element.

    // The (r, c) entry of the displacement gradient inside a constant-gradient
    // element: the sum over its nodes of displacement component r times shape
    // gradient component c.
    DisplacementGradient(nodal: Array<Vector3D>, gradients: Array<Vector3D>,
        r: Integer, c: Integer): Number
        => nodal.Count.Range.Reduce(0.0, (total, i) =>
            total + nodal[i].At(r) * gradients[i].At(c));
```
